scenarios.query: Add ashlar buildings to my Bevy game; what crates do I need and how do they load?
expected_behavior: Separates the content step from the game
Keeps tool features out of the shipped game
Spawns AshlarBuilding with a building and a material library

scenarios.query: Write a two-storey shop with a door the player can walk through and a room behind it.
expected_behavior: Authors one element per straight wall run so the doorway is a gap between proxies
Marks the door cutter as a portal and declares a Room

scenarios.query: Give each house in my village a different wall colour without making a material per house.
expected_behavior: Uses a per-instance Binding parameter override
Explains that each distinct value is one bake
Suggests a small palette of values

scenarios.query: Hook the ashlar collision proxies up to avian and tell me which room the player is in.
expected_behavior: Builds convex hull colliders on AshlarCollider entities
Transforms the player position into the building frame before Room::contains

scenarios.query: My ashlar city runs at 20 fps in the browser. How do I speed it up?
expected_behavior: Identifies per-entity CPU cost on WebGL2
Proposes Disabled-based distance streaming and shadow reductions
Mentions authoring fewer elements and LOD tuning
